business_overview.one_sentence: The Group is a Hong Kong-based vertically integrated jeweller selling self-designed jewellery through seven Chong Fai Jewellery stores, wholesale channels and recycled gold trading.

segments.business_substance: Retail sales through seven stores in Kowloon and the New Territories.
segments.source: 2023/24 annual report MD&A revenue by business, pp. 6-8

segments.business_substance: Wholesale jewellery products to other jewellery retailers.
segments.source: 2023/24 annual report MD&A revenue by business, p. 8

segments.business_substance: Sale of gold products recycled from the general public.
segments.source: 2023/24 annual report MD&A revenue by products/business, pp. 8-9

business_overview.revenue_model: Point-in-time sales of jewellery products and recycled gold products when goods are delivered; jewelcrafting service revenue recognized when services are rendered.
business_notes: Main products include gem-set jewellery and gold jewellery products produced in-house in Shenzhen.
Retail sales to customers are mainly cash or credit card; other customers can have credit period up to 90 days.
The company has customer reward scheme contract liabilities requiring future product redemption.
